catalog_source.integration: independent fixed-rule rebuild; source code is not executed or copied

rsi.average: repository SMMA initialized from first price change

fixed_candidates.threshold_long_short: literal daily +1 below RSI30, -1 above RSI70, flat otherwise
fixed_candidates.threshold_long_only: safety candidate: +1 below RSI30 and flat otherwise
fixed_candidates.head_shoulders_source_price: literal unused source function: seven-node short pattern searched on adjusted close
fixed_candidates.head_shoulders_rsi_corrected: fixed claimed intent: identical seven-node search applied to RSI

portfolio.weighting: equal absolute weight among active signed signals
portfolio.turnover: sum absolute change in traded asset weights from drifted holdings

promotion_gates.signal_coverage: at least 20 entries and exposure in both later windows
promotion_gates.primary_performance: positive annual return, Sharpe above 0.5, drawdown no worse than -25 percent
promotion_gates.stress: positive full and both later windows under 100 bps and 8 percent borrow
promotion_gates.dependence: absolute correlation no greater than 0.80 to core and trend
promotion_gates.blend: 80/20 blend improves Sharpe with no worse drawdown and familywise paired lower Sharpe difference above zero
